notes.title: Vote for "Spiritless Ltd." as "Outstanding Story-Rich Game"!
notes.notes:
Do you love funny stories, crazy characters and great puzzles? Then we have something special for you! Our game "Spiritless Ltd." is a classic point-and-click adventure game that offers all this and much more. 
We, two passionate hobby programmers, have invested a lot of time and effort in the development of this game to offer you adventure fans a few hours of fun and puzzles. If you appreciate our work and want to support us, then vote for "Spiritless Ltd." as "Outstanding Story-Rich Game" at this year's Steam Awards. We would be very happy about your vote!
